## Checklist

- [ ] Works in light and dark mode
- [ ] Dynamic Type and VoiceOver still behave
- [ ] Handles offline and slow-network states
- [ ] No new third-party dependencies, or the addition is justified below
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, provisioning profiles, or `.env` files committed
- [ ] No client names, customer records, or engagement details in code, comments, or screenshots
- [ ] Minimum OS version unchanged
- [ ] Docs or README updated if behavior changed
